title: Astrologaster
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#479, 2026-10-14), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal, recipes steam, controller-sdl, corefonts, dotnet48, vcrun2022, bloody-spell and xact, rated 2 of 5: stuck on Loading for 29 minutes after starting or continuing a game. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Steam has a Mac version too, which the reporter found broken (they are working with the developer). The Windows version through Highball starts but hangs on Loading after New Game or Continue, which matches a hang Windows players describe in the game's Steam discussions, so it may not be Highball's.

knownIssues.symptom: Stuck on Loading after starting or continuing a game
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; Windows players report the same hang in the game's Steam discussions
